hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: With n up to 10^5, quadratic matching times out.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Transform nums into a difference sequence of signs {-1, 0, 1}.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Use the Knuth-Morris-Pratt (kmp) string matching algorithm to count pattern occurrences in linear time.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear time KMP matching on transformed sign difference sequence.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n * m) substring comparisons exceed time limits for n, m up to 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) memory for prefix function pi.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate as exact pattern matching over integer alphabet using KMP or Z-algorithm.
